note: Curated candidate universe for the SELF-CONTAINED Pairs strategy (pairs_arb_scanner.py --self-contained). Hand-picked names that move together for a real economic reason -- sector ETFs, substitutes, index proxies, same-industry majors -- so the cointegration test is separating signal from noise, not fishing 80,000 random combinations.
